title: Report how much room each row has left
heading: MathOpt Stores Every Row as lb ≤ a·x ≤ ub, So You Write Rules as the Business States Them
cases: a <= row's room is its slack, and binding lists the rows with no room
a >= row's room is its surplus, activity minus bound, never negative
a ranged row's room is its distance to the nearer of its two bounds
a row whose room is floating-point noise counts as binding
